examples.title: enableDataDetector11+
examples.description:
enableDataDetector(enable: boolean)
Enables recognition for special entities within the text.
This API only works on devices that provide text recognition.
When enableDataDetector is set to true and the dataDetectorConfig attribute is not specified, the system recognizes all types of entities by default, and changes the color and decoration of these entities to the preset style.

examples.title: enablePreviewText12+
examples.description:
enablePreviewText(enable: boolean)
Sets whether to enable preview text.
This API can be called within attributeModifier since API version 18.
Atomic service API: This API can be used in atomic services since API version 12.
System capability: SystemCapability.ArkUI.ArkUI.Full
Parameters
Whether to enable preview text.
true to enable, false otherwise.
Default value: true
This API is disabled by default in C API scenarios. To enable preview text in such scenarios, set metadata in the module.json5 file of the project as follows:

examples.title: Example 1: Updating the Text Style
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to update the text style using the updateSpanStyle API. After modifying the style, you can use getSpans to obtain the updated style information of the text.

examples.title: Example 2: Binding a Custom Keyboard
examples.description: This example shows how to bind a custom keyboard to the component using customKeyboard.

examples.title: Example 3: Binding a Custom Menu
examples.description:
This example illustrates how to bind a custom menu to the component using bindSelectionMenu.
The paste menu item in this example involves reading pasteboard data. Therefore, you need to request permissions to access the pasteboard as required.

examples.title: Example 4: Updating the Image Style
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to update the image style using the updateSpanStyle API.

examples.title: Example 5: Binding a Gesture Event to a Span
examples.description: This example shows how to bind a gesture callback to a span.

examples.title: Example 6: Updating and Obtaining Paragraph Styles
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to update paragraph styles using the updateParagraphStyle API and obtain paragraph information within a specified range using the getParagraphs API.

examples.title: Example 7: Updating the Preset Style and Indent
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to update the preset text style using the setTypingStyle API and set paragraph indents using the updateParagraphStyle API.

examples.title: Example 8: Setting Text Weight and Shadow
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set text weight and shadow using the updateParagraphStyle API.

examples.title: Example 9: Adding Custom Layout Spans
examples.description: This example shows how to add custom layout spans using the addBuilderSpan API.

examples.title: Example 10: Using and Managing BuilderSpan in a Component
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to add a custom layout span using the addBuilderSpan API. APIs, such as getSpans and onWillChange, do not return the internal information of BuilderSpan. You need to manage the BuilderSpan state and update it when the component content changes.

examples.title: Example 11: Configuring Text Recognition
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to enable text recognition by setting enableDataDetector to true and configuring text recognition settings using the dataDetectorConfig API.

examples.title: Example 12: Setting Caret, Selection Handle, and Background Colors
examples.description: This example shows how to set the caret and selection handle color using the caretColor attribute and the text selection background color using the selectedBackgroundColor attribute.

examples.title: Example 13: Setting Line Height and Letter Spacing
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to configure text line height (lineHeight) and letter spacing (letterSpacing) using the updateSpanStyle API.

examples.title: Example 14: Adding a Custom Paste Event
examples.description: This example shows how to add a custom paste event to the component using the onPaste event and customize user paste behavior using the PasteEvent API.

examples.title: Example 15: Setting Text Feature Effects
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set text feature effects using the addTextSpan API and the fontFeature attribute. This example sets the FontFeature attribute to ss01, which changes the digit "0" from its original oval shape to a shape with rounded corners.

examples.title: Example 16: Setting Custom Keyboard Avoidance
examples.description: This example shows how to bind a custom keyboard using the customKeyboard attribute and configure whether the custom keyboard supports keyboard avoidance using the KeyboardOptions parameter.

examples.title: Example 17: Viewing the Editing State
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to obtain the current editing state of the rich text using the isEditing API. The onEditingChange event can be added to the component to log whether the component is currently in editing mode.

examples.title: Example 18: Configuring Text Change Callback
examples.description: This example shows how to add the onWillChange event to the component, which triggers a callback before the component performs any insert or delete operations.

examples.title: Example 19: Configuring the Enter Key Type
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the Enter key type of the soft keyboard using the enterKeyType attribute.

examples.title: Example 20: Setting the Paragraph Line Break Rule
examples.description: This example shows how to set the line break rule (lineBreakStrategy) using the updateParagraphStyle API and obtain the current line break rule using the getParagraphs API.

examples.title: Example 21: Using Basic Functionality of Styled Strings
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to bind a styled string to a RichEditor component using the setStyledString API in RichEditorStyledStringController. This feature is available since API version 20. The getStyledString API can be used to obtain the styled string displayed by the RichEditor component.

examples.title: Example 22: Obtaining Layout Information
examples.description: This example shows how to obtain layout information using the getLayoutManager API. It includes obtaining the total number of lines for the component content or placeholder using getLineCount, the glyph position closest to a given coordinate using getGlyphPositionAtCoordinate, and line metrics, text style information, and font properties using getLineMetrics.

examples.title: Example 23: Configuring Extended Options for the System Default Menu
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to configure extended options for the system default menu via the editMenuOptions attribute. You can customize the text labels, icons, and callback methods of menu extended options. This feature is available since API version 20.

examples.title: Example 24: Setting Common Component Attributes
examples.description:
This example shows how to set common attributes for the component. This includes the following:
- Set the scrollbar display mode using barState (available since API version 18).
- Configure whether the soft keyboard is automatically displayed when the component gains focus via non‑click triggers, using enableKeyboardOnFocus.
- Enable or disable haptic feedback for the component using enableHapticFeedback.
- Obtain preview text information using getPreviewText.
- Specify whether to prevent the back button press from being propagated to other components or apps, using stopBackPress.
This example shows how to set the scrollbar color of the RichEditor component using the scrollBarColor attribute, available since API version 21.

examples.title: Example 25: Obtaining the Caret's Relative Position Rectangle in the Component
examples.description: This example shows how to obtain the caret's relative position rectangle in the component using the getCaretRect method of RichEditorBaseController, available since API version 18.

examples.title: Example 26: Setting the Maximum Number of Lines and Maximum Number of Characters
examples.description: This example shows how to set the maximum number of characters using maxLength and the maximum number of lines using maxLines, available since API version 18.

examples.title: Example 27: Setting the URL Style for Text
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement text hyperlink using UrlStyle, which is supported by the addTextSpan and updateSpanStyle APIs. When users tap the formatted text, the app navigates to the specified URL. This feature is available since API version 19.

examples.title: Example 28: Configuring Style Behavior for Undo Operations
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to retain original content styles upon undo operations for RichEditor components that do not use styled strings. You can enable this behavior by setting undoStyle (available since API version 20) to UndoStyle.KEEP_STYLE.

examples.title: Example 29: Setting the Preset Paragraph Style
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the preset paragraph style using the setTypingParagraphStyle API, available since API version 20.

examples.title: Example 30: Setting Text Decoration Thickness and Multiple Decorations
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use thicknessScale of DecorationStyle to set the thickness of text decoration and enableMultiType to set multiple decorations, available since API version 20.

examples.title: Example 31: Enabling Automatic Spacing Between Chinese and Western Text
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to configure automatic spacing between Chinese and Western characters using the enableAutoSpacing attribute, available since API version 20.

examples.title: Example 32: Setting an AI Menu for Text Selection
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to configure the AI menu for text selection using the enableSelectedDataDetector API, available since API version 22.

examples.title: Example 33: Listening for the Input Method Binding Event
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the onWillAttachIME event to listen for the input method binding event, available since API version 22.

examples.title: Example 34: Deleting the Character at the End of the Text Box
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to call deleteBackward to delete the character before the caret in the editing state with a custom keyboard, available since API version 23.

examples.title: Example 35: Optimizing the Display of Minority Languages
examples.description:
This example uses the includeFontPadding attribute to add font padding at the top of the first line and the bottom of the last line of text. It also uses the fallbackLineSpacing attribute to implement adaptive line spacing which adjusts dynamically according to the actual text height.
The includeFontPadding and fallbackLineSpacing attributes are added since API version 23.

examples.title: Example 36: Enabling Leading Punctuation Compression
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to compress punctuation at the beginning of a line using the compressLeadingPunctuation attribute.
The compressLeadingPunctuation attribute is added since API version 23.

examples.title: Example 37: Setting the Drag Preview Style
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to set the drag preview style using the selectedDragPreviewStyle API.
The selectedDragPreviewStyle API is supported since API version 23.

examples.title: Example 38: Setting Single-Line Mode
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to set single-line mode using the singleLine API.
The singleLine API is added since API version 23.

examples.title: Example 39: Setting the Placeholder Text of the Styled String
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to set the placeholder text of the styled string using the setStyledPlaceholder API.
The setStyledPlaceholder API is added since API version 24.
